title: Episode 79 Conclusion and Episode 80 Opening — Mehar Singh and Gangu Shah’s Followers

blocks.text: The five volunteers are revealed alive, and the Guru honors them with the rank of martyrs because they had already surrendered themselves inwardly before any physical blow could fall. The page makes clear that willingness, not literal slaughter, established the title's deepest meaning.

Immediately afterward, Episode 80 opens with Mehar Singh, shifting the narrative toward Tat Khalsa discipline and conflict with the line associated with Gangu Shah. That abrupt handoff turns the page into a bridge between exemplary obedience and later sectarian dispute.
The result is a deliberate contrast. The tested Singhs stand as the measure by which later claimants, factions, and pretenders will be judged.
